line_items.work_text: Approval for issuing of administrative approval to GAD for an amount of Rs. 11,98,889/- against renovation, repair and extension of SEOC for implementation project Emergency Response Support System (ERSS) sponsored by NDMA.
Utilization of Balance Fund amounting to Rs. 1254.97874 lakhs under capacity building component of ASDMA.

narrative: The SEC deferred discussion on the agenda regarding ASDMA and approved the CA Audit Report of ASDMA for the financial year 2021-22. The SEC decided to drop the agenda on incorporating an additional clause in the service contract of DPOs and Field Officers (DM).
